targets.name: Typography Fit/Fill multi-round trial render
targets.evidence: Slow pages carry dozens of explicit _local_typography_*trial HTML/Chromium measurement artifacts; PPAT p011 also carries ten trial PDFs and alone spans about 8m16s.
targets.why_blocks_five_minutes: A single page can exceed the entire 300-second document budget because every trial launches measurement/render work before the final page is accepted.
targets.first_measure: Collapse/strictly bound trial count while preserving the current visual policy; implementation deferred.

targets.name: Per-page Chromium/PDF print lifecycle
targets.evidence: The frozen renderer prints each page independently and reprints the same zh_visual.pdf after lock/fill/fit.
targets.why_blocks_five_minutes: Twelve or nineteen independent browser/print lifecycles consume most of the effective 69m06s visual window; the five-minute target permits only seconds per page.
targets.first_measure: Reduce print lifecycle cardinality/batch document work; implementation deferred.

targets.name: Repeated production-path QA, PDF reopen, rasterize
targets.evidence: Accumulated QA closure is 31m02s, including repeated source/final PDF inspection; the full audit was also duplicated once.
targets.why_blocks_five_minutes: The verifier reopens/rasterizes artifacts already measured during production, so validation approaches or exceeds the complete target budget.
targets.first_measure: Reuse a production render ledger and separate fast gate from asynchronous full regression; implementation deferred.
